assets.name: hero
assets.subject: Dense gold/blue/violet iridescent metal and optical-glass blade vortex with a deep open center.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original production landing-page hero artwork for a premium creative software and digital-material studio, image only.
Scene/backdrop: seamless graphite black studio #101113 with a perfectly quiet near-black background fading to flat near-black at every edge, no floor line.
Subject: a complex floating organic vortex sculpture, densely but meticulously constructed from many finely engineered iridescent metallic ribbons and optical-glass blades. A sculptural spiral of nested inner and outer structures, woven fins, layered folds, interlocking curved blades, and deep internal voids. Many distinct overlapping depth planes and convincing thickness, with dramatic occlusion and a commanding asymmetric silhouette. Form one highly ordered main sculpture, not a scattering of separate pieces. This must be visually elaborate, sumptuous, and strongly three-dimensional.
Style/medium: extraordinarily refined photorealistic studio CGI, high-end digital art and industrial-design campaign finish; physical material realism, very precise crafted edges and surfaces.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, approximately 1536x1024 or higher appropriate output. Centered oblique three-quarter view, entire sculpture clearly visible, sculptural mass occupies about 74% of frame with clean dark margins. All silhouette extremities stay inside frame. Expansive intricate structure with an open spatial heart; avoid a simple ring, infinity sign, letter, or minimalist single loop.
Lighting/materials: multiple controlled broad softbox highlights articulate real depth, glossy liquid-silver and anodized iridescent metal coupled with thick clear optical glass. Coral-gold, electric-blue, and violet reflections running through precision surfaces; colorful with disciplined luminous highlights and deep shadows, not flat neon. Rich refractions and mirror reflections reveal inner layers.
Constraints: original standalone digital sculpture artwork only. No text, letters, logo, brand, watermark, arrows, interface, screen, website mockup, icons, checkerboard, particles, starfield, scenery, sci-fi circuitry, or random debris. No simple primitive forms. Keep background completely calm.
